name: Unlucky
description: Fate seems to conspire against them. Higher injury chance.

name: Dao Insight
description: Possesses an innate understanding of the Dao. Faster breakthroughs.

name: Bloodthirsty

description: Born under a dark star. Breakthroughs are perilous.
